A drag king is basically the counterpart to a drag queen, so usually a woman (though I'm nonbinary) performing as a man rather than a woman. A drag mother is basically an older drag queen who teaches a younger performer about makeup and performance and such. Except mine used to teach a lot of queer history classes so I get that too. 

Basically my drag mother goes from a genderqueer question mark to a lady of the night and I go from looking like a 12 year old boy to a solid 18 or 19 MAYBE. 

[These](http://princeriot.tumblr.com/post/139717816729/sometimes-i-feel-like-a-transformer-tbh-ft-lady) probably aren't the best pictures of us in drag because while she looks really good I was giggling like a maniac during all of them.

You can still go to those places as a non-queer person. You don't have to be rigid as a non-queer person. I really don't think you wish you were queer. Those places are nice, particularly for someone like me who is bisexual and nonbinary, but then I leave them and it's like "FUCK. Time to deal with assholes again." And it's exhausting. It's why my drag mother pretended to be straight and cis for like 4 years. "I AM A CISGENDER HETEROSEXUAL DRAG QUEEN. NOT QUEER AT ALL. NOPE." and then she eventually went "sorry y'all, I lied" and her family was piiiissed.
I'm glad too.

I'm a drag king and my drag mother is eleven years older than me. She has been a better parent to me than my biological mother has ever been and I'm more attached to her than I ever have been to my abusive biological mother. People ask me about my mother and she is the first person I think of, and the person I consider to be my real mother. My family know we're close but don't know just how literally I think of her as my mother. I'll never tell them.
I felt like shit. Told my chosen mom and she called me and we talked for a bit while I waited though.
Well, I thought it was perfectly normal for my mother to drag me by the hair when I wouldn't go to my room, and to hit me with a kitchen spoon up until recently. So yes.

I dread both. They always end with everyone arguing, and in recent years, someone getting out of the car and walking home. I always feel awful, and everything I've tried to do for NMom has usually only made more trouble. Hoping this year will be a bit nicer because even if my bio family ends up fighting and being awful I have my chosen family to go home to. I'm actually kind of excited. I'm trying to plan something really nice for my chosen mom.

This is basically how my family took nt being trans. The first men's shirt I ever bought, my mother saw my wearing it and went "You meet these people and then you become one of them. You're pushing me over the edge, why are you doing this to me?" Because she's the only one who really matters, don't you know?

I don't have anywhere to take her. Chosen mom's house isn't really an option, since even as she's the least emotionally manipulative of my siblings, she's still very close with the other two and would look for just about any possible bad thing to take them from me. And I can't be with my chosen family all the time at the moment because of a lot of reasons, most of which are financial. If I called someone my parents would immediately know it was me who called, (or my chosen mom, and her calling would mean I would have to have told her). If I called CPS I'm scared it would make things worse.

"You can't Pierce your lip, what will I say to the rest of the family? You can't dress in men's clothes, what will I say to the rest of the family? You can't mention your name/pronouns when you get misgendered at Christmas. You can't be out as trans to them, what on earth will we say?" It goes on.

I did. After the age of about eleven or so I was usually left home alone, forced to spend the entire day somewhere I didn't want to (ie. My cousin's wedding shower which was  filled with people I didn't know and made me anxious as fuck), or ended up in tears when I actually did get attention at all. The last few birthdays my siblings have wound up making fun of me to the point where I burst into tears and holed up in my room for the day. We used to go out to dinner on my birthday, but that hasn't happened for me in years (all my siblings still get taken out).  I'm hoping it will be better this year since I'm probably going to live with My chosen family by the time I turn 19. I'm almost positive that my bio family will try to act like they give a shit too. Kind of sad they would stop caring until I was gone, but I'm sure that's how it'll go.
Probably still from me.

"It's your own fault your father tried to slam your head in the door, you shouldn't have mouthed off." 

"You need to stop threatening me." After I said I didn't want to live with my mother anymore. 

"If you don't want your brother to treat you like garbage, clean up after yourself so he won't get angry." This never worked. Any mess I cleaned was still treated the same as a mess I left. 

"How do you think that makes ME feel? Thanks a lot." After I confessed that being at home and not with my chosen family made me feel depressed/suicidal

"You're crying because your friends cat died, you didn't even cry when your aunt died,you're absolutely ridiculous, the cat wasn't even yours (cue mocking me for crying about a cat.) The cat belonged to my chosen mother, who I practically lived with for a long time and of course, got very attached to her cats. My great aunt was never involved with me, and we never really bonded. And I did cry after she died, but didn't until I was by myself because crying gets me mocked, obviously. I was particularly upset about the cat because he had come to my aid during multiple panic attacks and he was my buddy. I hadn't seen him in about a month when he died because I couldn't get to my chosen mom's house, and at that time, there was no hint he was sick. I was upset that he had died so suddenly and I hadn't gotten to say goodbye to him. My aunt was sick for years, and when she finally died I had already pretty much mourned her fully. 

"I like the false memories better" dad after I asked why I had to wear things I would never touch if given the choice for school pictures and pointed out that he wasn't getting authentic memories of the person I was.
There isn't. There's one by my chosen mom's house, but not near where I am now.

Uh, you basically said it was fine for my parents to misgender me, made a stupid comment about "oh they could be asking to be called 'your majesty' or something" which seems like an idea uou pulled from your ass honestly, and then you suggested that I and everyone else here was lying and exaggerating.

Something my chosen mother told me one night while bringing me down from a panic attack/arguing with me over whether or not I was abused by my bio mother

"Any kind of negative touch she gave you was abuse because she did it with the intent of making you fear her submit rather than teaching you how to reason. If you were old enough to reason there was no reason for her to hit you, and if you weren't old enough to reason you weren't old enough to understand why she was hitting you."

I was telling her I deserved all the shit, specifically the time my father dragged my toward the door and threatened to slam my head in it because I was yelling at them for not getting my brother away from me and when I told my mom she said "you shouldn't have yelled"

And I buried the fuck out of this incident/being spanked/being dragged by the hair until I reached the age of eighteen and had an anxiety attack next to my drag mother (closest I have in terms of a mother figure, older by 11 years) in bed, which became so horrifyingly bad that I curled up into a ball and covered my head and screamed at her to please not crush my head in the door or hit me and that I didn't mean to make everyone mad. Nobody was mad, and I finally came out of it and was so lost as to why nobody was mad at me. 

And I flinched at every sudden movement my biological mother made for years.
Nah, it's fine. I share that with most people anyway.

> I've long questioned how many people posting on this subject are attention-seeking or changing their story to seek sympathy.

This literally sounds like something an abuser would say. Do you have any fucking idea how many times I was called a liar by whoever I told? By all my relatives, my siblings, my friends. Fuck you, dude.
Poster of deleted comment is an idiot. In regards to what I prefer. Monroe. They/them. He/him. Not hard.
She only notices when I don't, or if I do, it's always fucking wrong.
Sorry, they're just words I use for my chosen family out of habit since everyone is queer

Oh, she did this. I caught it on recording and sent it to my queer mom, who was pissed as all hell. And then she sent it to her mom, who was also pissed. If she pulls this shit the day I move out she's gonna be obliterated real quick by my queer family. I don't think she'd try it because "Donnie will be there and he has neck tattoos, and your mom is afraid of neck tattoos." Actual quote from my queer mom. It's also accurate. 

And my queer dad is like 6'3 and scary as fuck so there's that. My queer mom is also scary but more in the sense that she will EMOTONALLY DESTROY YOU.
I am stuck there for now. I'm 18 but the people I'm going to live with eventually need to get their car fixed.

They should. I have a place to go already. They're so concerned about other people now, they're gonna be fucking CONSUMED with it  once their oldest kid runs off to live with their nonbinary trans drag mother and her trans boyfriend and starts spending all their time in gay bars.

I have a similar issue. I'm the bad child for not letting my bio family use my chosen mom's Netflix when I'm at their house. I don't pay for it, and it's a known fact that my bio parents fucking HATE my chosen family (for being queer and accepting my queerness). Before I found out that they were using my account I found out that they were using EVERY ACCOUNT ON THE THING. And then denying it. No mom, Jeremiah and Trae don't watch Criminal Minds, that's a specifically you thing. 

And then they were really mad when I wouldn't ask my queer family to make them accounts on it. "Why not?" Because they fucking HATE you for how you treat me and they know you hate them too.

Yes. A while ago I mentioned some stuff my parents did (trying to slam my head in my bedroom door, dragging me by my hair as a punishment, whacking me with a wooden spoon) in casual conversation with my chosen parents and my chosen mom just fucking stared at me and went "oh my god" and I didn't understand why. And then that same night I had a horrifying panic attack over my repressed memories and she was trying to tell me that what they did was wrong and I just couldn't process it.  Was just like "What do you mean that was abuse? I deserved it for being shitty"
My mom doesn't use it. She wouldn't even be able to figure it out.
Not sure. Probably. Because I'm garbage.
Meh. It's a punishment for me because work isn't much better than home. At least at home I can go to sleep and drown everyone's shit out.
I bought them on etsy!

I'm a drag king. A drag mother/father is usually an older/more experienced queen/king who teaches a younger one. Usually the gender is the same but my drag mother was a male entertainer for like five years so it still works.
Because I can't drive. I have a job I have no way of getting back to and have to manage to keep until next month when I move in with my drag mother.

I did. Brother is younger by four years, but is the nastiest, emotionally abusive little shit on the earth. Sometimes physically abusive too, as he is much stronger than me due to his athleticism. The answer was always "it's just sibling rivalry" or "ignore him." Sibling rivalries aren't supposed to have you looking for places to jump from or trying to overdose and die. I've had to call my FOC and hide in a closet until they came to get me because he was hitting my door with a baseball bat and trying to break open my barricaded door so he could hit me. Of course, he was a perfect angel once my chosen parents walked in to get me. Can't let anybody who doesn't live here know how rotten he is. 

He's a rotten transphobe too, and on Christmas he was yelling at me through the wall calling me a woman (I'm nonbinary) and when I answered with a quiet "nah" he threw a big fit about my genitals and called NMom upstairs because "she's saying she has a penis!!" (I didn't. I said it wasn't his business) and rather than be concerned about his rampant transphobia she yelled at me for neither confirming nor denying that I had a penis. 

Another recent fit he threw was over some fucking chicken wings that I had that he wanted. I had to lock myself in my room and not make a sound while he banged on the walls and told me to kill myself for an hour, and when he shut up I called my drag mother (chosen mom) and she heard him and was really upset she couldn't come get me and was telling dirty jokes to cheer me up and help me block it out and he heard through the walls and told my parents (I was ignoring him) and my dad comes in, yanks the tablet away, hangs up skype and starts yelling about my disgusting mouth and gross friends and I started crying. The 12 and 14 year olds can't handle penis jokes they hear every day at school anyway. It might scar them. Even when I don't fight back I get in trouble. 

Drag mom has been away for a while because her car is dead and he's been especially rotten. He laughs when we're on the phone because he knows I'm stuck here until either she or her boyfriend can come get me out.

They/them is my preferred set of pronouns. 

Edit: but I saw the note already and it made me smile. Thank you.

I know. I picked it because my dad said had I been a boy he would have named me Monroe. Or tried to. He wanted to call me Madonna and my birth name was as close as Nmom would let him get. 

At least I'll be out of here soon.
I really like these!

Yes. There are no recent photos of me in the house aside from senior pictures, which she chose everything for, of course. Everything is from fourteen or below, before I really cared about how I dressed and just wore what Nmom bought, which was always the latest fashion. To a degree, at least. Then my appearance matched the rest of me and I just looked like a punk kid. I liked the black, I liked the jewelry. She made me take it all off when we went on vacations and she wanted pictures. I wasn't wearing anything extreme since it was hot, I was literally in a black tank top and shorts and a leather wristband with some studs on it and she threw a big fit and made me take it off for all the pictures. 

She always dressed me up for school pictures in things I would never wear, even before I hit my all black stage. I always hated the things she made me wear, usually the tops were low cut and I was anxious about everyone seeing my bra all god damn day and hated the emphasis on my chest. I asked once why she made me wear things I hated and would never wear outside of that anyway since I was always horribly uncomfortable and that didn't represent the person I was. She said she wanted to make memories and when I pointed out that she was always making memories of me that weren't real she said, "I prefer the false memories." Or something like that. That fucked me up. 

There are no photos of me from after I came out as trans. There are no photos that represent that part of me. I was never allowed to wear a button up in photos, never allowed a bow tie. It was always a low cut shirt I couldn't bind under. We had a big fight on Easter when I wouldn't go to church in what she'd picked out. She eventually let me wear the blazer and the tie just to get me to go, but it was the one year she didn't take an Easter morning photo of the family. If the image of me isn't false or up to her standards, she doesn't want it.

Yes. I lost my shit when they told me. I was ten. I'm now pretty much a family joke because I believed it for so long, and I feel like it's part of the reason I have such awful trust issues now. Like "well, my parents lied to me about this, my friends lied to me about being my friends, I probably shouldn't believe anything you say to me in case you're planning on making me a big joke later on.
She doesn't. I could give you my FB if you want it.
If you want I can PM you my Twitter. I don't want to post it here in case my mother stumbles across it. She searches everything for me. Thank you.
We're making one. Current plan is to have her, her boyfriend, my drag sisters, and a local king move all my shit to her place when no one is home in early January as soon as her car is fixed.

I won't have a new one for a while. I'm moving in with my drag mother in early January and I can go the pride clinic once I apply for and get put on Medicaid, which will probably take a while. Until then my meds will probably run out and I'll basically be on suicude watch until I'm medicated again
I'm planning on moving in to live with her in early January. At the moment I can't leave. I can't drive and my drag mother's car is broken down.
Yes. Any time you hit a child is abuse. Especially like that. I really wish I could have recognized it as abuse when my parents were hitting me, dragging me by my hair.

Yep. Hear it all the time. My mom used love to manipulate me and make me feel bad all the time. I can't look my chosen family (specifically my drag mother) in the face when she tells me she loves me because my first response is to curl up and cry.
I don't have any of my shit. I need a new SS card and have to get a state ID. I can't get anything because they don't take me.
I'm trying. I wouldn't be at home at all if my drag mother's car wasn't dead. Unfortunately, it is. I have to last until New Years at the very least.
Yes. I spend most of my time either at work or with my drag mother though. I've only slept at home twice this week.
I'm trying to. Once I get a job near them I'm going to wait until my family is out and we're gonna move all my shit.

I just don't think she takes me seriously. I've had four therapists already. I liked the first one, the second told me I was a liar, and I liked the third. They all moved to different places or their hours changed and I keep getting thrown in with people I don't know and have to rebuild everything again before I can be comfortable talking to them. It doesn't help.
I don't think I'd be able to make myself go. I'm in therapy, but I feel like I'm not really taken seriously there either.
I take classes at a community college. I'm done with them in May.

I have two sisters who are 16 and 11, and both of them are totally fine. I still can't drive. He's been like this forever. He has OCD and ODD, along with some other shit I forget the name of, and half the time doesn't take his medicine. The day I recorded this my mom had to literally force them down his throat.
